signals.label: Demonstration profile
signals.detail: This is an internal QA profile and does not describe a real clinic.

heroHeadline: A clearer VELURIA patient journey for your clinic.
heroIntro: this demonstration shows how a verified clinic signal can shape the VELURIA product story, AI experience and consultation pathway without inventing services or making outcome promises.
productFit: The profile can match Silk Skin, Ultra Lift or Pearl Tone to the visible skin-quality conversations already supported by the clinic's verified public offering.
pipelineOpportunity: The clinic can show real product proof, let prospective patients explore the cosmetic AI experience and follow genuine interest into a structured consultation pathway.
consultationRationale: Use the free clinic growth map to review product fit, the proposed patient journey and one practical launch step.
serviceMenuBridge: The VELURIA range can be presented as four clear skin and hair pathways, supported by an enquiry journey that gives prospective patients a reason to start a consultation.
teamCapacityOpportunity: Build a repeatable service that appropriately trained and competent clinic team members can support within the clinic's governance and protocols.

productFitNotes.silk-skin: A skin-quality pathway for patients asking about texture, radiance, firmness and elasticity.
productFitNotes.ultra-lift: A separate firmness and revitalisation conversation for patients focused on tone and elasticity.
productFitNotes.pearl-tone: A clarity and luminosity pathway for patients concerned about uneven-looking tone.
productFitNotes.hair-force-plus: A professional scalp and hair vitality pathway that can open a distinct consultation conversation.

hairConsultationRationale: Discuss whether a dedicated scalp and hair vitality pathway is suitable for the clinic's services and practitioner team.

heroEyebrow: A VELURIA patient journey prepared for Clinica London
heroHeadline: Connect facial rejuvenation expertise with a clearer skin-quality journey.
heroIntro: this private preview explores how an enzyme-led professional range, responsible visual engagement and structured consultation follow-up could complement the clinic's existing surgical and non-surgical facial rejuvenation pathway.
productFit: VELURIA Silk Skin could support a conversation around visible surface quality, smoothness and radiance, while Ultra Lift could support a separate firmness and elasticity pathway. Final suitability and product selection remain with the treating clinician.
pipelineOpportunity: Clinica London can introduce the range through verified product education, show a real VELURIA result, let prospective patients explore the cosmetic AI experience and move genuine interest into a structured consultation journey.
consultationRationale: Use the free Clinic Growth Map to review how VELURIA could complement Clinica London's existing facial rejuvenation services, staff education and patient journey.
serviceMenuBridge: Clinica London's established facial rejuvenation pathway creates a credible bridge into professional skin-quality conversations, while Hair Force+ can be assessed separately as a potential new scalp and hair service.
teamCapacityOpportunity: VELURIA could support an additional repeatable skin-quality service without requiring every treatment appointment to sit in the medical director's diary, subject to practitioner competence, training and clinic governance.

productFitNotes.silk-skin: Complements existing facial rejuvenation conversations with a visible focus on texture, radiance, firmness and elasticity.
productFitNotes.ultra-lift: Creates a distinct firmness, tone and revitalisation pathway alongside Clinica London's established rejuvenation options.
productFitNotes.pearl-tone: Adds a professional brightness and even-looking tone conversation without implying whitening or treatment of pigmentation disease.
productFitNotes.hair-force-plus: Offers a separate scalp and hair vitality pathway that should be assessed with the clinic team before launch.

hairConsultationRationale: Review whether Hair Force+ could support a dedicated scalp and hair vitality consultation pathway at Clinica London.

productFit: VELURIA Silk Skin could support a conversation around visible texture, radiance and elasticity; Ultra Lift could support a separate firmness pathway; and Pearl Tone could support a clarity and even-looking tone conversation. Final suitability remains with the treating clinician.
